note: Camping is on a small mown patch at the west end of the gravel boat-ramp lot on the Lamine River, with a privy at the lot; the concrete ramp is alongside and the river is about 30 m away behind the bank trees. No pads or tables. Reached by gravel Buffalo Prairie Drive: 2 miles from Route HH, or 1 mile from Bryant Bottom Road off I-70 exit 89. --Claude
summary: Confirmed and stays under the lot rule: MDC marks a Primitive Camping point (map symbol and GIS point) on the grass at the west edge of the ramp lot. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy written; phone matches. Pin is on the camping point. Not waterfront stands; a riverview lead is reported but not shown.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays, as Lick Creek): the area page (6.8 acres, 'There is a boat ramp located on this area') lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. No brochure is published. The map (7/21/2021) has a 'Primitive Camping' legend entry and draws that symbol west of the Parking Lot / Privy / Disabled Accessible symbols, with the Concrete Boat Ramp between and below them. GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point (OBJECTID 280) at 38.92210,-92.98101 = the stored pin; the one GIS lot (1488, ADA) is 49 m east. On the frame the lot is a gravel strip about 75 x 15 m along the south side of the entrance road; the camping point sits at its south-west corner on a mown grass patch about 20 x 20 m between the lot and the bank trees, immediately west of the ramp. So camping here is beside a ramp lot, but at a designated point with its own patch of ground.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; what the point sees): from the camping point to the water of the Lamine River is about 30 m (imagery estimate); between are the rest of the mown patch and then a belt of bank trees about 15-20 m deep. The ramp cut is 15-20 m east of the point and opens a line of sight down to the water beside the patch rather than in front of it. The river is about 30-35 m wide here. The frame is leaf-on and there are no official photos, so I cannot show a view from the patch; nothing is an open apron to the water (trees, and the ramp is day use). Stored not waterfront stands; a riverview would need a ground photo.

ACCESS: 'From Pilot Grove, take Route HH northwest 4.50 miles, then Buffalo Prairie Drive (gravel) north 2 miles. From exit 89 on I-70, take Bryant Bottom Road (south side of I-70) east 1 mile, then Buffalo Prairie Drive south 1 mile to the area.' Gravel county road, no ford, limit or 4WD wording; the map shows Buffalo Prairie Drive bridging the Lamine just west of the access. The lot's entrance road is drawn 'MDC Unimproved Road' on the map though it is a 150 m gravel drive on imagery.
PIN: stored 38.92210,-92.98101 is the GIS camping point on the grass patch. No move.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the area page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands; nothing on the page or map dates the camping. The bottom floods (the whole access is river bottom) - no closure is posted now.
